title: Do productive capabilities affect export performance? Evidence from African firms
summary: There is limited empirical evidence on productive capabilities and their effect on firm-level export performance in Africa. The paper builds indicators that treat productive capabilities as a mix of technological and production capabilities, and finds both significantly drive firms' direct export performance.
keyFindings: Technological and production capabilities both significantly drive firms' direct export performance.
Stronger capabilities make firms more efficient and competitive, supporting policies that build them.
methods: World Bank Enterprise Survey data for firms in 29 African countries, estimated with a censored regression model.
